# gitea_releases (Data Source)

Use this data source to list releases in a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_releases" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `releases` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases))

<a id="nestedatt--releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `releases`

Read-Only:

- `draft` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `prerelease` (Boolean)
- `tag_name` (String)
- `target_commitish` (String)
- `title` (String)
